children.game_version: A 'freeze dance' where children must vibrate their hips when the music plays and stop when it hits a silent beat.

seniors.seated_version: Perform hip isolations and gentle vibrations while seated in a firm chair.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a stable barre or chair for balance while performing slow hip sways.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by half; limit the range of hip motion to avoid lower back strain.

social_formats.description: Performed at weddings in a communal, celebratory social setting.

movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rapid movements of the hips and buttocks

signature_moves.description: Rapid, rhythmic shaking of the hips and buttocks in time with folk music.
signature_moves.name: Hip Vibration

music_profile.sound_description: The music consists of local popular folk songs from the Gulf region, characterized by strong rhythmic foundations that drive the dancer's movements.

basic_steps: Assume a stable stance with knees slightly bent
Isolate the pelvic region from the upper torso
Initiate a rapid vibration of the gluteal muscles
Coordinate the hip oscillations with the percussive beat of the folk song
teaching.formation: Usually performed individually or in informal groups within a social setting
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and muscle isolation of the lower body.
teaching.rhythm: Fast-paced, synchronized with local folk percussion
